description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.

uses.name: Charnel Serenade
uses.cardState: with three or fewer time counters on it
